title: Failed Sign-in Uplift: Temporary Lockouts Before a Late Review Decision
content:
**Product:** Harborline Customer Accounts

**Rule.** The failed sign-in uplift of the late-review goodwill follows the account's temporary sign-in lockouts that began after the same calendar date two months before today: three or more add $6.00, one or two add $3.00, and none add nothing. The uplift is a fixed sum added to the late-review goodwill figure. Each lockout is recorded on the account history with the moment it began.

| Temporary sign-in lockouts that began after the same calendar date two months before today | Uplift |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | $6.00 |
| 1 or 2 | $3.00 |
| none | nothing |

**Counting (hypothetical dates).** With today 19 September, lockouts that began on 20 July or later are counted; a lockout that began on 19 July is not.
